about.nfts: ARGENTUMS is a collection of 10,000 unique NFT characters inspired by Argentum Online, minted on the Ethereum blockchain. Each one has unique traits based on the game's classes, weapons and armour.

faq.subtitle: FAQ
faq.title:
Frequently Asked
Questions
faq.a1: AO Libre is a collaborative project using open-source as a banner. Everyone is invited to participate by making modifications to the code, graphics, sounds, adding items, spells, mapping or being part of the organization of the game within the server. All our resources and code are released under the GPL license and can be found on Github.
faq.a2: Yes, you can download the game from here and play in any server either fan-maintained or maintained by AO Libre's staff.
faq.q3: How do I contribute to the project?
faq.a3: You can contribute in many ways: programming, updating guides, reporting bugs, playing on the server, creating your guild, being a game master, or simply being part of the community in the chat. All our source code is available on GitHub.
faq.q4: How do I run my own server?
faq.a4: It's very easy and takes about 5 minutes. Check out this guide on Reddit for step-by-step instructions.
faq.q5: How do I buy an ARGENTUM NFT?
faq.a5: First, you'll need to have an Ethereum wallet. You can create one and buy Ethereum on platforms such as Kraken, Satoshitango or BuenBit. Then set up the Metamask chrome extension. Finally, you'll be able to buy ARGENTUM NFTs directly on our website.
faq.a6: An NFT (Non-fungible token) is a piece of digital asset (image, video, audio...) that lives in the blockchain. Once you buy an NFT, it belongs to you, and no one can copy or distribute it.
faq.a7: ARGENTUMS are 10,000 lovable characters generated as Non Fungible Tokens eternally written on the Ethereum blockchain. These ARGENTUMS have varying traits that make each unique and collectible. These are the official ARGENTUMS of the AO Libre community. Beware of scams.
faq.a8: Check in the ARGENTUMS NFTs Collection section.
faq.q9: How can I get an ARGENTUM?
faq.a9: ARGENTUMS will be available to mint directly from our website by connecting your Metamask wallet. You can also purchase from the secondary market on OpenSea. Use only official links from our Discord channel.
faq.a10: $AOLB is an experimental BEP-20 token on the Binance Smart Chain. It is a community experiment and has no utility inside the game. It does not grant any in-game advantages, items, or privileges.
